label: Bible Study
prompt: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our _____: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verse: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
note: 'Let us make man' — the only creation act with a divine conversation before it, and the image comes with a job: dominion.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way _____.
verse: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
note: Freshly baptized on a desert road, the Ethiopian treasurer went on his way rejoicing.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a _____, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
verse: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
note: Michal watched from a window as David leaped and danced before the ark — and she was not a fan.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most _____ flame.
verse: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
note: The Song's climax: love strong as death, jealousy cruel as the grave, its coals a blazing fire.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy _____ delight my soul.
verse: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
note: When anxious thoughts multiply, God's 'comforts' delight the soul — the KJV's answer to a racing mind at 3 a.m.
